function.name: cad_drawing
function.description: contract: only action/type, no IDs. Else latest cad_status.documentId/stateId (inspect_sources too). inspect:type+documentId+stateId. Owner IDs separate; native, no caches. PDF:cad_file.

function.name: cad_inspect
function.description: IDs/authors mm/rad; id=object ID, not documentId; model_contract id=type. drawings:sheet IDs; drawing_views/dimensions:sheetId; timeline:partId; recipes:inputs; sketch_geometry:entities/rank.

function.name: cad_command
function.description: cad_status.commands, exact document/state. HISTORY:cad_history. Pre-commit cancel rolls back; committed succeeds.

function.name: cad_select
function.description: Exact inspected occurrence/body: documentId/stateId/full path; bodyId/revision for bodies; reject stale/ambiguous.

function.name: cad_workspace
function.description: list.expected verbatim; keep IDs/nulls; target separate. User switch cancels.

expected.description: list.expected verbatim; keep IDs/nulls; target separate.

activeSessionId.description: Null only if latest list.expected.activeSessionId is null.

documentId.description: Null only if latest list.expected.documentId is null.

stateId.description: Null only if latest list.expected.stateId is null.

function.name: cad_file
function.description: save/export/report/pdf/template_export: read contract; exact documentId/stateId, absolute path, explicit overwrite, template id. Receipt:bytes/hash/source/diagnostics. Non-save:history end. PDF rejects stale references; no undo. Report actual path/hash; never claim a rejected or failed file write succeeded.

function.name: cad_history
function.description: Exact documentId/stateId+cursor(null=end); reject stale. timeline; suppress:result revision. Reorder:IDs/dependencies/operands at history end. Rollback:session only. Preview:changed=false, previewChanged/cursor.

function.name: cad_edit
function.description: Exact document/state, mm. Contact/G2:sketch_geometry contract, id/revision. Offset:sketchId/revision, seeds(loop=1), distanceMm, join(default Miter). Returns IDs; no guessed topology.

function.name: cad_parameter
function.description: Atomic mm/rad/scalar. Read state/parameter_targets; full IDs. New expression/reference:omit id; edits keep id. References cannot drive; bind rejects drivers; unbind:binding id; delete guards users. Returns IDs/state.
